npm_availability: NOT ON NPM. @joernio/astgen on npm publishes only up to 2.0.4 (verified: `npm view @joernio/astgen@3.47.0` -> E404, versions end at 1.0.18/2.0.1..2.0.4). astgen 3.x is distributed only as GitHub source (joernio/astgen-monorepo) plus release binaries. An npm pin+integrity for 3.47.0 is therefore impossible; using npm's 2.0.4 would be a version MISMATCH against the pinned Joern and is deliberately NOT done.

integrity_anchor.method: source build pinned by git commit (the authoritative integrity anchor for a not-on-npm component)

build_recipe: PATH=<node22>/bin:$PATH yarn install --ignore-engines   # engines want node>=24; tsc builds under node22

astgen_bin_launcher.note: MACHINE-LOCAL, NOT COMMITTED. jssrc2cpg locates astgen via the ASTGEN_BIN env var (jssrc2cpg AstGenRunner: binEnvVar = ASTGEN_BIN). The machine-local jssrc2cpg.sh shim sets it explicitly.

validation: check_js_frontend.py validates this toolchain on study/napi_status/js_frontend_fixture/minimal.js BEFORE any real package (4/4: non-empty JS CPG, normalized facts, the fixture function present, non-empty calls).
claims_boundary: toolchain provenance only; no runtime-behavior or security-impact claim.
